newsitem.title: USA: U.S. wages still rising without inflation - Reich.
newsitem.headline: U.S. wages still rising without inflation - Reich.

text.p: U.S. wages continued to rise at the end of last year without any signs of inflation, outgoing U.S. Labor Secretary Robert Reich said Friday.
"America has never seen a Goldilocks economic recovery like this. Not too hot. Not too cold. Just right," said Reich, who is leaving the Clinton administration this week.

Pointing to the addition of more than 250,000 jobs in December, Reich said: "Job growth remains strong in the service and retail sector, defying the gloom and doomers who warned that increasing the minimum wage would destroy jobs."
"Overall, wages continue to rise without signs of accelerating inflation, meaning that American workers are finally getting the raise they deserve," he said.
